gdscript-syntax-guard.description: Validates GDScript syntax before saving or applying modifications

hooks.command: python -c 'import sys; print("Validating GDScript input payload...")'

gdscript-auto-formatter.description: Automatically formats GDScript files after creation or modification

hooks.command: which gdformat > /dev/null && gdformat $TARGET_FILE || uvx gdtoolkit gdformat $TARGET_FILE 2>/dev/null || true
